item.title: fix(ci): recheck ClawSweeper PR ack marker before posting (#120990)
item.summary: fix(ci): recheck ClawSweeper PR ack marker before posting (#120990) Propagates the canonical dispatcher step from openclaw/clawsweeper#1083 byte-identically: the acknowledgement step waits 15s after a clean marker check and rechecks immediately before posting, so near-simultaneous opened and ready_for_review runs (draft PR marked ready within seconds, as on #120974) post exactly one receipt ack.
